everfall.config.title: Everfall Settings
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.back: Show particles behind buttons, text, and images. Disables interaction.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.inte: Particles can rest on buttons and be swept away or grabbed with the mouse. Unavailable when "Particles in the background" is enabled.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.show: Show particles in your inventory, pause menu, and other in-game menus.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.prof: The current theme. Unavailable when "Automatic seasonal profile selection" is enabled.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.auto: Change the theme to match the time of year in your region. Uses your time zone, system region, and in-game language.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.maxP: Maximum number of particles on screen.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.wind: Wind strength and direction: negative values blow left, positive values blow right.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.grav: Positive values pull particles down, negative values lift them up. At zero, particles float.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.pixe: Display pixels give smoother movement. GUI pixels follow the interface grid.
everfall.feature.fireflies.desc: Fireflies circle near the bottom of the screen in spring and summer, from 21:00 to 05:00.
everfall.feature.custom.desc: Add this effect when the time and season are right.
everfall.debug.countOption.desc: Show the Everfall particle counter while F3 is enabled. F3 also toggles it in the main menu.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.everfall: Adds interactive background particles to menus.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.everfall: Adds interactive background particles to menus.
